step_notes.ENGINE_DEFAULT: The engine's own default has no step after CAPS_0_80_0_40: its off is rung 4, sequential selection, which keeps a distinct Captain per row until the pool is exhausted. An uncapped joint solve has no Captain differentiation.
step_notes.POLICY: A policy whose default fractions equal the requested pair exactly takes CAPS_OFF (its overrides and structural bounds stay) before structural rung 1. Any other explicit value is the operator's and is not touched by these steps.
